stem: Shaan's school flagpole is $15\,\mathrm{m}$ tall. A classmate standing beside it is about $1.5\,\mathrm{m}$ tall. Shaan wants to make sense of the $15\,\mathrm{m}$ height.

parts.text: Which claim correctly compares the flagpole height with a familiar height?

options.text: Read only the printed $15$ and stop there.
Compare with the classmate: the flagpole is about $10$ classmate-heights, or $13.5\,\mathrm{m}$ taller.
Choose $15$ because it is the largest printed number in the stem.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Same-unit comparison with the classmate gives a multiple of about 10 and a difference of 13.5 m.

teacher.key_rationale: A familiar same-unit reference (difference or multiple) makes sense of 15 m. Reading 15 alone omits the reference. Picking the largest print is a surface grab.
